views.name: race_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  race_id,
  year,
  round,
  circuit_id,
  name,
  date,
  time,
  url,
  fp1_date,
  fp1_time,
  fp2_date,
  fp2_time,
  fp3_date,
  fp3_time,
  quali_date,
  quali_time,
  sprint_date,
  sprint_time
FROM races
views.description: Normalized one-row-per-race projection exposing core race attributes. Use to join race metadata (year, round, circuit) into analyses and to avoid repeated column selection/aliasing. | Use for: List races by year/round or date; Join race metadata to results/qualifying/lap_times; Filter races that have sprint/quali/fp dates populated

views.name: race_ext_basic
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  race_id,
  year,
  round,
  circuit_id,
  name,
  date,
  time,
  url,
  is_pit_data_available,
  short_name,
  has_sprint,
  max_points
FROM races_ext
views.description: Normalized projection of races_ext for use when extended/denormalized race attributes (short_name, has_sprint, is_pit_data_available) or numeric date/time variants are needed. | Use for: Identify races with sprint sessions; Use numeric/denormalized race metadata in analytics; Join extended race attributes to event facts

views.name: driver_dim
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  driver_id,
  driver_ref,
  number,
  code,
  forename,
  surname,
  dob,
  nationality,
  url
FROM drivers
views.description: Canonical driver dimension (one row per driver) exposing name components, code, number and nationality. Use for labeling and joining driver attributes to facts. | Use for: Display driver names and demographics; Join driver attributes to results/qualifying/lap_times; Filter drivers by nationality or DOB ranges

views.name: constructor_dim
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  constructor_id,
  constructor_ref,
  name,
  nationality,
  url
FROM constructors
views.description: Canonical constructor (team) dimension exposing reference, name and nationality. Use for labeling and joining constructor attributes. | Use for: Show constructor names and nationalities; Join constructor details to results/constructor_results/standings

views.name: result_fact
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  result_id,
  race_id,
  driver_id,
  constructor_id,
  number,
  grid,
  position,
  position_text,
  position_order,
  points,
  laps,
  time,
  milliseconds,
  fastest_lap,
  rank,
  fastest_lap_time,
  fastest_lap_speed,
  status_id
FROM results
views.description: Normalized per-result fact rows from results table exposing common measures (points, milliseconds, laps) and identifiers for joins. | Use for: Aggregate points per driver/constructor/season; Filter finished vs non-finished via status join; Compute average lap/milliseconds statistics across results

views.name: qualifying_attempts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  qualify_id,
  race_id,
  driver_id,
  constructor_id,
  number,
  position,
  q1,
  q2,
  q3
FROM qualifying
views.description: One row per qualifying attempt exposing Q1/Q2/Q3 times and qualifying position for joins or time-based comparisons. | Use for: Compare qualifying position to race grid/finish; Find best Q3 times or drivers who progressed through sessions; Join qualifying times to race results

views.name: lap_times_raw
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  race_id,
  driver_id,
  lap,
  position,
  time,
  milliseconds
FROM lap_times
views.description: Raw lap-times fact table (one row per lap per driver per race) exposing milliseconds for numeric analysis and raw time string for display. | Use for: Compute per-lap averages or best lap per driver; Join lap times to results to analyze stint performance; Filter laps by lap number or position

views.name: pit_stops_raw
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  race_id,
  driver_id,
  stop,
  lap,
  time,
  duration,
  milliseconds
FROM pit_stops
views.description: Pit stop events (one row per pit stop) exposing durations in milliseconds and human time as present in source data for joins to race and driver. | Use for: Analyze pit stop durations per driver/team/race; Align pit stops to lap times to detect pit-in/out laps

views.name: driver_season_points
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.year AS year,
  res.driver_id AS driver_id,
  SUM(res.points) AS total_points
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
GROUP BY r.year, res.driver_id
views.description: Aggregated total points per driver per season (year) computed by summing results.points across races joined to races to obtain year. Useful for season-level ranking and comparisons. | Use for: Who scored the most points in a season; Compare driver seasonal performance across years; Prepare inputs for driver season rankings

views.name: constructor_season_points
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  r.year AS year,
  res.constructor_id AS constructor_id,
  SUM(res.points) AS total_points
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id
views.description: Aggregated total points per constructor per season by summing results.points joined to races.year. Useful for championship tallies and season-over-season trends. | Use for: Season constructor standings by points; Track constructors' points progression across seasons

views.name: best_lap_per_driver_race
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  race_id,
  driver_id,
  MIN(milliseconds) AS best_lap_milliseconds
FROM lap_times
GROUP BY race_id, driver_id
views.description: Best (minimum) lap milliseconds per driver per race. Useful to compare fastest laps by driver within a race or to compute lap delta metrics. | Use for: Identify each driver's fastest lap in a race; Compare fastest laps across drivers; Correlate best lap to finishing position or stint

views.name: results_with_driver_constructor
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  res.result_id,
  res.race_id,
  res.driver_id,
  d.driver_ref,
  d.forename,
  d.surname,
  res.constructor_id,
  c.constructor_ref,
  c.name AS constructor_name,
  res.grid,
  res.position,
  res.points,
  res.milliseconds,
  r.year AS year,
  r.round AS round,
  r.name AS race_name
FROM results res
LEFT JOIN drivers d ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id
LEFT JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
LEFT JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
views.description: Denormalized results joined to driver and constructor dimensions and race metadata. One row per result including driver and constructor attributes for easy reporting. | Use for: Tabular race result reports with driver/constructor labels; Filter results by season/constructor/driver attributes; Compute head-to-head between drivers in a season

views.name: driver_best_finish_per_race
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  race_id,
  driver_id,
  MIN(CASE WHEN position_order IS NOT NULL THEN position_order ELSE position END) AS best_position_order
FROM results
GROUP BY race_id, driver_id
views.description: Best (minimum) finishing position per driver per race derived from results.position_order/position. Useful to detect best classification when multiple result rows exist per driver/race in edge cases. | Use for: Resolve multiple result rows per driver/race; Compute position-based aggregates robust to position_text variants

views.name: status_lookup
views.description: Simple status lookup to map status_id to status text for readable joins with results and retirements. | Use for: Translate status_id to human-readable status; Filter finished/retired/disqualified results

views.name: retirements_per_race
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  race_id,
  retirement_type,
  COUNT(*) AS retirement_count
FROM retirements
GROUP BY race_id, retirement_type
views.description: Count of retirements per race with breakdown by retirement_type. Useful for race-level incident summaries. | Use for: Summarize incidents per race; Identify races with high numbers of retirements or specific failure modes

views.name: lap_positions_raw
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  race_id,
  driver_id,
  lap,
  position,
  lap_type
FROM lap_positions
views.description: Raw lap-by-lap position records (one row per race_id, driver_id, lap) exposing lap_type for filtering starting grid vs race positions. | Use for: Track positional changes across laps; Compute overtakes or position delta vs grid
